nodes.description: Public string state variable holding the collection name 'Alpha Pass'.
Public string state variable holding the token symbol 'AP'.
Public uint256 cap on total mints, default 1000, owner-settable.
Public uint256 mint price, default 0.1 ether, owner-settable.
Public string prefix used to build token metadata URIs.
Mapping(uint256=>bool) tracking which Whale token IDs have already been minted as Alpha Passes.
Counter of Alpha Pass tokens minted so far, compared against maxSupply.
External ERC721Enumerable contract reference (0x27a0...0F9F) queried for balances and token IDs.
Deploys ERC1155 with the default URI template and initializes Ownable owner.
External payable mint: validates payment and supply, then loops over the caller's Whale tokens, calling external contract views and minting un-minted IDs.
Public view returning baseURI concatenated with the token ID string, guarded by mintedTokens existence check.
Public view that delegates to WhaleContract.totalSupply().
onlyOwner external setter that rewrites baseURI.
onlyOwner external setter that rewrites price.
onlyOwner external setter that rewrites maxSupply.
Caller-controlled address used as payer, Whale balance owner, mint recipient and owner-gate subject.
External call to untrusted WhaleContract.balanceOf(msg.sender) executed before any state update in mint.
External call to untrusted WhaleContract.tokenOfOwnerByIndex(msg.sender, i) inside the mint loop.
Arithmetic expression price * amount used in the payment requirement.
Arithmetic expression totalMinted + amount used in the supply cap requirement.
Internal ERC1155 _mint call that writes balances and triggers receiver acceptance callbacks after external reads.
User-supplied uint256 parameter of mint() controlling payment and desired mint count.
uint256 parameter of uri() identifying the token whose metadata is requested.
string parameter of setBaseUri() assigned to baseURI.
uint256 parameter of setCurrentPrice() assigned to price.
uint256 parameter of setMaxSupply() assigned to maxSupply.
Local uint256 caching WhaleContract.balanceOf(msg.sender), also the loop bound.
Local uint256 counter of tokens minted in the current mint() call, used for the break condition.
Local uint256 holding the Whale token ID for the current loop index, used for minting and dedup check.
Local uint256 loop index over the caller's Whale token list.

edges.reason: The amount parameter is consumed by mint() as the quantity of Alpha Pass tokens requested.
amount feeds the price * amount payment computation.
The stored price state variable is multiplied by amount.
The price * amount result gates mint() execution via require(price * amount <= msg.value).
totalMinted counter is added to amount for the supply check.
amount feeds the totalMinted + amount supply computation.
maxSupply is compared against totalMinted + amount.
The totalMinted + amount result gates mint() execution via require(totalMinted + amount <= maxSupply).
msg.sender is passed as the account argument of the external WhaleContract.balanceOf call.
The WhaleContract state variable is the target of the balanceOf external call.
The value returned by balanceOf is stored in the wBalance local variable.
mint() makes an external call to an attacker-influenced contract before mintedTokens/totalMinted are updated, enabling reentrant re-entry.
wBalance is the bound of the for loop indexed by i.
The loop index i is passed as the index argument to tokenOfOwnerByIndex.
The WhaleContract state variable is the target of the tokenOfOwnerByIndex external call.
msg.sender is passed as the owner argument to tokenOfOwnerByIndex.
The token ID returned by tokenOfOwnerByIndex is stored in wTokenId.
The mintedTokens mapping is read and written throughout mint().
wTokenId indexes the mintedTokens deduplication check.
wTokenId is used as the token type id in the _mint call.
msg.sender is used as the recipient of the _mint call.
_mint performs the state-changing mint (and ERC1155 receiver callback) after external contract reads, ordering exploitable by reentrancy.
The minted local counter controls the loop break condition inside mint().
Each newly mintable wTokenId increments the minted counter.
totalMinted is incremented after each successful _mint.
mintedTokens[wTokenId] is set to true after each _mint.
The tokenId parameter is consumed by uri().
baseURI is concatenated into the returned metadata URI.
mintedTokens[tokenId] guards uri() via require(mintedTokens[tokenId]).
The newUri parameter is written into the baseURI state variable.
The onlyOwner modifier on setBaseUri compares owner() with msg.sender to authorize the write.
The newPrice parameter is written into the price state variable.
The onlyOwner modifier on setCurrentPrice compares owner() with msg.sender to authorize the write.
The newSupply parameter is written into the maxSupply state variable.
The onlyOwner modifier on setMaxSupply compares owner() with msg.sender to authorize the write.
totalSupply() delegates to the external WhaleContract.totalSupply() call.
mint() repeatedly calls the untrusted WhaleContract inside the loop before completing its own accounting.

normalization_plan.reason: amount is the mint() call parameter; it only exists to feed mint() requirements and loop logic.
tokenId is the uri() call parameter used solely for the mintedTokens check and metadata lookup.
newUri is the setBaseUri() parameter immediately assigned to baseURI.
newPrice is the setCurrentPrice() parameter immediately assigned to price.
newSupply is the setMaxSupply() parameter immediately assigned to maxSupply.
wBalance is a mint() local caching the external balanceOf result and the loop bound; it has no independent identity.
minted is a mint() local counter used only for the in-loop break condition.
wTokenId is a mint() local holding the per-iteration Whale token ID used for dedup and _mint.
i is the mint() loop index used only to index tokenOfOwnerByIndex.
